tokens.v: Full-bleed photograph filling the entire frame edge to edge with no border, frame, letterbox band or matte of any kind. Long-cooled pahoehoe an hour after dawn, the rope folds silvered with a fine glassy bloom and cold to the touch. The phone stands leaned back at a shallow angle in the trough between two coils, titanium rail turned to camera and the frosted charcoal back taking the flat blue of the sky, the display face reading dead mirror-dark with no interface in it, the body holding a little over half the frame height. 50mm at f/2.8 from crust height a forearm away, the whole background thrown soft: a hundred metres behind, an active fissure sits as a low ember-orange smear with a thread of heat shimmer above it — atmosphere only, nothing hot anywhere near the product. A tilted plate of cooled crust cuts in hard from the left edge on the same focus plane as the phone and occludes its lower corner. The titanium rail carries one unlettered laser-etched maker's dot, and that dot takes the single warm highlight in the frame.
